title: The Sand Dollar - Sunset Cruises and Boat Tours
specs: Cycleboat is Delaware’s first and only human-powered cycleboat
Cycleboat has a collapsible canopy covering entire deck
Sand Dollar is a 45' pontoon powerboat with open and partially covered seating and bathroom
Cycleboat cruises designed for 21 and over; children allowed if can pedal adult-size bike and accompanied by adult over 25
Maximum weight capacity 2,960 pounds on Cycleboat
All Cycleboat captains are US Coast Guard certified Master Captains
Cycleboat accommodates up to 15 guests; 10 pedal stations and 5 bench seats
Minimum 6 riders needed to pedal Cycleboat; refunds if minimum not met and no reschedule
Private cruises available on both vessels with tailored pricing
includes: Live narration by boat captain on daily cruises
Ice and water in coolers on Cycleboat
Trash removal and cleanup handled by crew
gap: Exact price per person for Cycleboat cruises not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy daily cruises on a 45' pontoon powerboat with open and partially covered seating, including family sightseeing, happy hour, and sunset cruises. The Cycleboat is a 31-foot human-powered catamaran propelled by pedaling riders, with an electric backup motor. Private cruises are available on both vessels with tailored pricing.
extraNote: Full refund if cancelled more than one week before cruise · $100 late cancellation fee if cancelled within one week for private cruises · No refund for no-shows · Refund if unsafe conditions cause cancellation on day of cruise · Cycleboat sails rain or shine; captain may cancel for extreme weather with refund · Dock located behind the Rusty Rudder Restaurant at 113 Dickinson Beach, DE 19971 · Summer
